page.title: Telegram bots
page.subtitle: Bots that automations can use to send Telegram messages. Automation builders only see the bot name, never its token.
page.empty: Create a bot with @BotFather, add it to your group or channel, then paste its token here.
page.whoSees: Only organization owners and admins see this page. A step of a base that a bot is no longer shared with fails until the bot is shared again or the step changes.

form.description: The token is stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: What automation builders choose, e.g. “Sales” or “IT support”.
form.tokenKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the saved token; type a new one to replace it.
form.scopeHint: Automations of other bases cannot choose this bot.
form.noBases: This organization has no base yet.

errors.format: This is not a Telegram bot token (it looks like 123456789:AAH…).

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: Automations cannot send with this bot any more. A bot still used by automations cannot be deleted.
delete.loadingUsages: Loading the automations using this bot
delete.usages_one: {{count, number}} automation uses this bot: change it first.
delete.usages_other: {{count, number}} automations use this bot: change them first.
delete.notificationBot: This bot sends members their notifications. Choose another notification bot first (“Notification bot” above).
delete.notificationBotBlocked: It cannot be deleted while it sends members their notifications. Choose another bot, or no bot, under “Notification bot” first.

notificationBot.title: Notification bot
notificationBot.description: Members link their own Telegram to this bot to receive their notifications there. One bot per organization; automations can keep using it.
notificationBot.none: No notification bot yet: members cannot receive notifications on Telegram.
notificationBot.label: Notification bot
notificationBot.hintFirst: Members can link Telegram once a bot is chosen. Nothing is sent to anyone when you save.
notificationBot.hintChange: Changing or removing the bot unlinks everyone: each member has to link Telegram again.
notificationBot.noBots: Add a bot below first, then choose it here.
notificationBot.tokenHint: This is the notification bot: replacing the token with another bot's makes every member link Telegram again.

webhookConflict.title: Telegram sends this bot's messages elsewhere
webhookConflict.body: The bot has a webhook set by another system, so Cellhive cannot receive /start. Remove that webhook (deleteWebhook) or create a bot only for Cellhive with @BotFather and choose it here.

invalidToken.title: Telegram refuses the bot's token
invalidToken.body: The token was probably revoked in @BotFather. Paste the new token with “Change” in the list below, or choose another bot.

confirm.description: Every member who linked Telegram is unlinked.
confirm.changeBody: Notifications will come from “{{name}}”. Members have to link Telegram again from their notification settings; until then they get nothing on Telegram.
confirm.removeBody: Nobody will receive notifications on Telegram any more, and the links members made stop working.

toast.removed: Notifications are no longer sent on Telegram.

mode.pollingHint: Cellhive asks Telegram for new messages. Works on any server; a /stop is handled within 15 minutes.
mode.webhookHint: Telegram sends each message to Cellhive right away. This server must be reachable from the internet over HTTPS (PUBLIC_URL).
mode.unavailable: Webhook is not available: this server is not reachable over HTTPS. Polling works the same for members.

webhookError.title: Telegram cannot deliver messages to Cellhive
webhookError.body: Telegram reported delivery errors, or the webhook was changed elsewhere. Check that PUBLIC_URL is reachable from the internet, then choose Webhook again — or switch back to Polling.

publicUrl.title: This server is not reachable over HTTPS
publicUrl.body: The webhook needs PUBLIC_URL to be an https address on port 443, 80, 88 or 8443. Keep Polling — members get their notifications the same way — or ask the person who runs this server.

conflict.title: This bot already sends its messages to another webhook
conflict.intro: Cellhive never replaces a webhook that another system set. To use the webhook mode:
conflict.step1: Remove that webhook where it was set (another bot tool, n8n…), or create a bot only for Cellhive with @BotFather and choose it above.
conflict.step2: Then choose Webhook and apply again.
conflict.meanwhile: Until then the bot keeps receiving messages by polling.

mode.tokenHintWebhook: If the new token is another bot's, receiving goes back to polling: choose Webhook again afterwards.

toast.webhook: Telegram now sends this bot’s messages straight to Cellhive (webhook).
toast.polling: Cellhive asks Telegram for this bot’s messages again (polling).
toast.fellBack: The token belongs to another bot, so receiving went back to polling. Choose Webhook again in “Notification bot” if you need it.
